# evroc_subnet (Resource)

Provides an evroc subnet resource within a VPC.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the subnet. Must be unique within the project.
- `vpc_ref` (String) Reference to the VPC this subnet belongs to. Accepts FQID or plain name.
- `zone` (String) Zone for the subnet (e.g., a, b, c).

### Optional

- `ipv4_cidr_block` (String) IPv4 CIDR block for the subnet. Must be within the VPC's CIDR range, prefix /16 to /29. Required when stack_type is 'dual-stack' (default).
- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region where the subnet is created. Defaults to provider region.
- `stack_type` (String) Stack type: 'dual-stack' or 'ipv6-only'. Defaults to dual-stack.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs) for organizing and selecting resources.

### Read-Only

- `assigned_ipv6_gua_block` (String) Publicly routable IPv6 GUA block assigned to the subnet.
- `attachment_refs` (List of String) References to resources attached to this subnet.
- `available_ipv4_address_count` (Number) Count of unassigned IPv4 addresses in the subnet.
- `available_ipv4_ranges` (List of String)
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the subnet was created (RFC3339 format).
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified resource ID (FQID). Use this to reference this resource from other resources.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `subnet_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the subnet.
- `system_labels` (Map of String) System-managed labels automatically set by evroc (read-only).
- `using_ipv4_address_count` (Number) Count of IPv4 addresses currently in use.
- `using_ipv4_ranges` (List of String)
- `using_ipv6_address_count` (Number) Count of IPv6 addresses currently in use.
- `using_ipv6_ranges` (List of String)
